description: Extracciones e Inyecciones de Gas Natural SISTRANGAS is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Centro Nacional de Control del Gas Natural (CENAGAS). Histórico de extracciones e inyecciones por punto de extracción e inyección del gas natural a partir del 2015. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Centro Nacional de Control del Gas Natural (CENAGAS). Its tags are combustible, energía, explotación hidrocarburos, extracción, gas. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
